wpa_numbered_subset.what: The 105 rows of the wpa-lists job's NUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv dated 1862-1899, copied unchanged; used when jobs/wpa-lists/output is absent (that job is on branch wpa-lists until merged).

lord_subset: jobs/early-orders-hunt/data/lord_subset/UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES_pre1900.csv (hashes in that job's data/PROVENANCE.json); jobs/wpa-lists/output/UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv when present
richardson: jobs/richardson-volumes/output/RICH_*_ORDERS.csv, with that job's lord_entries and wpa_ids citation links
indian_reservations: jobs/indian-reservations-1912/output/IR1912_ACTS.csv, with that job's lord_seqs and numbered_eo links
books: jobs/early-orders-hunt/output/books/*_pages.jsonl.gz (MR_* and GLO_*), read for dated 'Executive order' mentions

source_universe.what: A series-level map of the archival and printed series that could hold an executive order 1789-1899, with each series' search status in this project as of 2026-10-18. Statuses: searched_to_end (the series was read or parsed completely by a job), sampled (some items read, no systematic pass), planned (routes written, not executed), not_searched, inaccessible_online (needs an archive visit or a scan request). Compiled by Claude from the repository's own records and the repositories' public finding aids; record-group and microfilm numbers should be confirmed against the current NARA catalog before a request is sent.
